title: SURE memory extraction declaration
description: Structured output of the extract_lessons unit (memory design spec 4.4). Declares this run's memory candidates (directory names under artifacts/candidates/) or an explicit no-new-lessons outcome. check_memory_extraction.py validates it together with every candidate's proposal.json / proposal.md. Constants use enum, not const, because the skill hooks' validate.ts only understands enum.

no_new_lessons.description: true when this run yields no new entry; then candidates is empty and no_lessons_reason says why. Normal for a clean success run.

no_lessons_reason.description: why there is nothing new (or why the candidates were dropped); required when no_new_lessons is true

covered_by.description: entry ids (<target_skill>/<slug>) whose lesson already covers what this run showed

candidates.description: single-segment directory names under artifacts/candidates/, each holding proposal.json + proposal.md; at most config max_candidates_per_run

infra_noise.description: true when the run was disturbed by infrastructure (queue, node, network); then every bad_case candidate must carry cell.cause infra

infra_evidence.description: path or path:line under the run directory that shows the disturbance; must be non-empty when infra_noise is true
